handoff_contract: Slot workers may read only the manifest-declared sources for their assigned slot as evidence and may emit only that slot-local compiled output; anti-overlap coordination happens only through the predeclared shared-memory keys, and only the session compiler may assemble the manifest-defined final document and bibliography.
memory_read_contract: Before finalizing a slot, slot_compiler may read coordination notes under tito.gmm.global.* and sibling tito.gmm.slot-XX.coverage keys only to avoid duplicate definitions, repeated openings, and scope drift; never treat memory as evidence.
memory_write_contract: Each slot_compiler writes concise coordination notes only under its own namespace (tito.gmm.slot-XX.coverage and tito.gmm.slot-XX.handoff); only session_compiler may write global smoothing/assembly notes under tito.gmm.global.*.
